new_value: Delivered test/vectors/relay_signer_chain.json: 12 vectors (7 frame + 5 sequence) per decided option (b) of worker6-nxew. Coverage: (1) multi-hop A->B->C chain - rsc_chain_origin_A_broadcast (B first-contact pins origin A) + rsc_chain_hop1_B_resigned_broadcast (B re-signs with own SIID/own counter/own key; C pins the immediate signer B, never payload origin A; payload is the wire_format_v2.json announce corpus verbatim, cross-checked at generation time) + rsc_seq_downstream_pins_immediate_signer_not_origin (C accepts B re-sign with zero knowledge of A; documents rule 3 announced-candidate bootstrap for A's own zero-hop frame); (2) RFC 6554 SRH destination-mutation variant - rsc_srh_origin_A_unicast_to_B (pinned-first accept) + rsc_srh_hop1_B_unicast_to_C_dst_mutated (link DST mutated inbound B-EUI64 -> outbound C-EUI64; only relay B's key can cover the mutated transcript); (3) fail-closed substitution - rsc_substitution_unknown_attacker_own_siid (zero verifying candidates -> reject, nothing pinned) + rsc_substitution_victim_siid_no_fallback (attacker X reuses victim B SIID; X's key cryptographically VERIFIES the transcript as a recorded decoy yet receiver MUST verify only against pinned B key and reject: spec 02 4.2 rules 2+4); (4) pinned-SIID key-mismatch TOFU violation fails closed (same vector); (5) cache behavior per decided semantics - rsc_seq_first_contact_pin_then_replay_rejected, rsc_seq_eviction_invalidates_replay_state (rule 5: eviction drops replay state so lower counter 368 < high-water 400 is acceptable as fresh first contact), rsc_seq_lower_counter_replay_rejected_without_eviction (control), rsc_seq_substitution_attack_leaves_trust_store_intact, plus reference frame rsc_cache_B_lower_counter. Option (b) = zero wire change, so the bead's conditional regeneration of signed-frame corpora (only for option a/c) correctly does NOT apply. Oracle independence: generator imports only reference_schnorr48.py (PyNaCl/libsodium) and hand-assembles frames from the spec 4.1 wire table + 4.2 LLSec bit table; lichen.crypto.schnorr48 and all Rust/C code never consulted; provenance recorded in-file.
